name: Liliana "Lun-Lun" Guenther
original_name: リリアーナ・ルン・ルン・ギュンスター
source:
The Storm Princess of the ocean kingdom of Renstanza, and a competitor in the Princess Waltz. She's a high tension character, a pleasure seeker always in good spirits. "Battle should be flashy and fun" is her motto, but she's incredibly serious about her participation in the Waltz.
She May not look like it, but she is in fact by far the oldest Participant in the Waltz.
She has Massive Ice, Water and Wind Abilities with which she crushes her enemies.

[from [url=http://www.jlist.com/product/P015]J-List[/url]]
